connection.connection: Could not reach the SoulFire server. Check the URL, make sure the server is running, and try again. For a web connection, also check HTTPS and browser access settings.
connection.authentication: The token was rejected or has expired. Check the token and try again.
connection.permission: This account cannot access the SoulFire server. Ask the server administrator for access.
connection.unexpected: Could not connect to the SoulFire server. Check the URL and token, and make sure the app and server versions are compatible.

newUser: New to Soulfire? Read the getting started guide.

connect.title: Choose where Soulfire runs
connect.description: Your bots run on a Soulfire server. The bots then join the Minecraft server that you pick in the next steps.

integrated.title: Run on this computer
integrated.description: Soulfire downloads and starts a local Soulfire server for you. You do not need to install Java or configure anything.
integrated.webDescription: Needs the Soulfire desktop app. A browser cannot start a local server.
integrated.getDesktop: Want to run bots on this computer? Get the desktop app.

dedicated.title: Connect to a Soulfire server
dedicated.description: Use the address and login of a Soulfire server that you or your team already runs. This is not your Minecraft server address.

demo.title: Try the demo
demo.description: Look around with sample data. The demo is read-only and Soulfire does not save changes.
demo.linkDescription: Opens a read-only demo with sample data in your browser. No setup needed.

integrated.preparing: Preparing to start the local Soulfire server...

toast.error: The local Soulfire server did not start

reset.success: Soulfire data reset successfully. Try starting again.
reset.confirmDescription: This permanently deletes the data of the local Soulfire server on this computer, including its projects, accounts, proxies, and scripts.

integrated.description: Soulfire manages a local server for you. It stays on this computer and stops when you close the app.

jvmArgs.title: JVM arguments
jvmArgs.description: Java VM arguments for Soulfire. Add <bold>-Xmx4G</bold> to use 4 GB of RAM. The default is 25% of available RAM.
jvmArgs.reset: Reset JVM arguments to the default

mobile.description: To run the Soulfire server on this device, you need to complete a few manual steps.

termuxCommand.title: Termux command
termuxCommand.description: Install the Termux app. Run this command in Termux to install the Soulfire server. Run generate-token api to create a token. Then enter the token below.

token.title: Token
token.description: Token to authenticate with the local server.

autoStart.title: Start automatically next time
autoStart.description: Skip server selection and use these settings when Soulfire opens.

softwareRendering.title: Force software rendering
softwareRendering.description: Uses bundled software rendering and does not try to use system Vulkan drivers. This may help with driver-related crashes. Can be slower and use more CPU. Requires Soulfire server 2.11 or newer.

integrated.title: Start Soulfire on this computer

plan.prepare: Downloads the matching Soulfire server and Java runtime the first time
plan.start: Starts the Soulfire server in the background
plan.connect: Signs you in and opens your dashboard

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: The defaults work on most computers. Change these only to troubleshoot or to run your own server build.

progress.label: Startup progress
progress.description: The first start can take a few minutes while Soulfire downloads what it needs.

prepare.title: Prepare files
prepare.description: Checks the Soulfire server and Java runtime, and downloads them if needed.

start.title: Start the server
start.description: Java is running and the Soulfire server is loading.

connect.title: Connect and sign in
connect.description: The server is up. Soulfire is signing you in.

port-in-use.title: Another program is using the server port
port-in-use.description: Close other Soulfire windows or programs that use this port, then try again.

out-of-memory.title: The server ran out of memory
out-of-memory.description: Close other programs and try again. If you set -Xmx in the JVM arguments under Advanced, change that value.

java.title: Java rejected the startup arguments
java.description: Open the startup settings and reset the JVM arguments under Advanced to the default.

custom-jar.title: The custom server jar did not run
custom-jar.description: Open the startup settings and select the official server, or import the jar again.

download.title: Soulfire could not download a required file
download.description: Check your internet connection and try again.

unknown.title: The server stopped before it was ready
unknown.description: Try again. If it keeps failing, the server output below shows the cause, and you can copy it for support.

dedicated.description: Enter the address of the Soulfire server, then sign in. Your Minecraft server address goes in a later step.

address.title: Address
address.description: Address of the Soulfire server, not the Minecraft server. The default port is 38765.

token.title: Token
token.description: API token from this Soulfire server.

emailCode.description: If you have an account, we have sent a code to <bold>{{email}}</bold>. Enter it below.
